description: This file defines a React component ChatBox, which provides a conversational UI with features such as chat messaging, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech. It handles user input, communicates with backend APIs, manages voice capabilities, and renders the chat interface with animations and controls.

classes.name: ChatBox
classes.description: React functional component implementing a chat interface with voice and text features.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Handles sending of user message, updates message state, and manages streaming or fallback API responses.

methods.name: speakText
methods.description: Uses Web Speech API to vocalize a given text message.

methods.name: toggleRecording
methods.description: Starts or stops speech recognition based on current state.
